verdict.rationale: Algolia is API-first. The Search API covers searching, configuring, and managing indices and records. The CLI and agent skills extend programmatic control to settings, rules, synonyms, analytics, recommendations, and crawling, and an official MCP server and multi-language clients exist. However, several documented workflows are described only as dashboard actions, with no API equivalent shown: Merchandising Studio's visual curation, analytics Download and Comparison mode, and connector schedules/transformations "configured in the Algolia dashboard." The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at every path tried, so no machine-readable spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API equivalents for dashboard-only features (merchandising, analytics export, connector configuration), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of parity.
